defects.title: Empty ledger treated as zero consumption unless product affirms completeness
defects.detail: Phase 4C computeRemaining treats no applicable usage as determined zero (remaining = gross). Mission requires missing utilization history to remain UNKNOWN. Product-layer honestRemaining(…, UNKNOWN) now refuses to publish full remaining when utilizationAffirmedComplete is false. Phase 4C core unchanged.

defects.title: RESTORE_CAPACITY has no encoded contractual-authority gate in Phase 4D core
defects.detail: Phase 4D restores any existing usageId (LEDGER_USAGE_NOT_FOUND otherwise). Reclassification requires RECLASSIFIABLE_TO; restore does not. Product recipes refuse RESTORE_CAPACITY without contractualAuthorityRef. Core left unchanged to preserve contracts.

defects.title: Financial overlays do not chain across sequential transactions
defects.detail: Each simulateTransaction overlays CHANGE_METRIC on the immutable approved snapshot. advance() chains capacity state + proposed ledger only. Cumulative pro-forma metrics across a sequence require a restated snapshot or cumulative caller-stated deltas. Documented; not a silent ledger mutation.

defects.title: No product applicator previously composed the 12 business forms into Phase 4D effects
defects.detail: Engine supported compositional effects; product UI still used legacy simulateDebtIncurrence for some paths. Closed for recipe/demo surface by transaction-effect-recipes + sequential runner; live dashboard wiring remains out of scope.

defects.title: Amendments affecting capacity are not Phase 4D effects
defects.detail: recipeAmendmentAffectingCapacity fails closed with AMENDMENT_REQUIRES_NEW_CAPACITY_GRAPH. Operative IR must be re-bound (Phase 3) before capacity re-evaluation.

defects.title: Real frozen corpus has 0 reclassification edges and 0 quantified shared pools
defects.detail: Basket reclassification and quantified shared-capacity execution remain synthetic-only proofs (Phase 4D README).
